newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam tenders to buy third-quarter products.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam tenders to buy third-quarter products.

text.p: State-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) has issued a tender seeking a total of 551,000 tonnes of oil products for the third quarter, an industry source said on Thursday.
The tender includes a demand for 218,000 tonnes of diesel, which is higher than the second quarter purchases of 177,000 tonnes, the source said.
The tender calls for 89,000 tonnes of 0.5-percent sulphur diesel, up from the second quarter purchases of 60,000 tonnes of the same grade.
Vietnam is seeking its diesel in six 23,000-tonne cargoes and four 20,000-tonne cargoes.

In other products, the tender seeks 144,000 tonnes of 83-RON, 0.15 gram per litre leaded gasoline in eight cargoes of 18,000 tonnes. In the second quarter, Vietnam purchased six 18,000-tonne cargoes, totalling 108,000 tonnes.
For the third quarter, the state company also tendered for seven 27,000 tonne cargoes of 170-cst, 3.0-percent sulphur fuel oil, totalling 189,000 tonnes.
This compared with 130,000 tonnes of the same grade in the second quarter in five 26,000-tonnes cargoes.

A Petrolimex source said that Vietnam has decided to buy more 0.5 percent sulphur diesel, rather than 1.0-percent, to help meet demand for electricity generation in the face of a possible shortage of hydro-power due to the dry season.
He also said the price of the 0.5-percent diesel was now comparable to the 1.0-percent grade, making it economical to buy the lower sulphur product.
